_comment: Map provider policy. No mapping vendor is named anywhere in the RFP - Exhibit 1
lists only Loqate (address verification, asterisked). Provider choice is
therefore an open item for the design phase, which is exactly why it lives in
'none' is the default: a schematic plot with zero network egress. It is the only
safe default while the Privacy Impact Assessment is outstanding, because a loss
address is Confidential data and loss_address is flagged PII in the field
Tile requests always go through the API's own proxy endpoint, never direct from
the browser. That keeps any subscription key server-side, gives a single
auditable egress point, and lets residency policy be enforced server-side.

osm._note: Development and demonstration only. Not an Aon-approved vendor.

azure._note: Enterprise-consistent candidate: Exhibit 1 already standardises on Azure for API Management, Functions, App Service, Service Bus and Blob Storage. Set AZURE_MAPS_KEY to enable.

_country_overrides_note: AE is forced to schematic because config/countries/AE.json sets data_residency.must_remain_in_region = true (NFR-12).
